task_reconstruction: Split annual production into a single-use stream and the rest, age each stream by a lifetime, call the untreated part harm, cut the single-use share until next year's harm slows by a tenth, then reopen the share with substitutes, policy, awareness and removal, and grade countries by a weighted score.
